listCustomFeats.name: Adrenaline Flow
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Trigger You Step
Frequency Once per Round

Blood flows in your veins and help you stay
fresh and awake. Gain temporary Hit Points
equal to half your level that last until the
beginning of your next turn.

listCustomFeats.name: Adrenaline Rush
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Trigger You take damage and lose all temporary Hit
Points from Adrenaline Flow

When your body remembers the danger you got
yourself into, it lets you strike like a cornered
beast. You gain a +1 status bonus to melee
attack rolls and damage with your Fist and free
hand weapons rolls until the end of your next
turn.

You can chose to instead gain a +2 status bonus
to the same rolls for one minute, but if you do
so, you can't use Adrenaline Flow for one minute

listCustomFeats.name: Always Moving
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
One way to survive any battle is to never be
where your foe expects you to be. While you're
not wearing medium or heavy armour, you're
permanently quickened. You can use your extra
action only to Step.

listCustomFeats.name: Battlefield Control
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance


You leave your blades in place your enemies
shouldn't forget them. Send a blade within a
space within your blade's first range increment.
The copy then starts floating inthe chosen space
for a maximum of one minute.

You gain the Punitive Strike reaction

listCustomFeats.name: Belch Inferno
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wearing your portable forge and can use Tenacious Furnace

For a few seconds, you heat your forge to
temperatures high enough to melt it away. You
Belch Slag and immediatly use Tenacious
Furnace. Your forge weakens anyway, but the
area of Belch Slag increases to a 45 ft. cone. Its
initial damage die increases by one step, and
creatures take the persistent fire damage on a
failure of the Reflex saving throw. On a critical
failure, this persistent damage is doubled.

listCustomFeats.name: Belch Slag
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wearing your portable forge

By overheating your furnace, you send a wave of
burning ash and metal in a 15 ft. cone. All
creature in the area take 4d6 fire damage with a
basic Reflex save against your blacksmith DC.
Creatures that critically fail this save also take
4 persistent fire damage.

At 10th level and every two levels thereafter, the
initial damage increases by 1d6 and the
persistent fire damage increases by 1.

listCustomFeats.name: Blacksmith Dedication
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You're a wandering metalworker who has
learned to temper and reforge steel on the fly.
You become expert in crafting and gain a
Portable Forge, a special Blacksmith's Toolkit
that hold and protect the fire you need to work.

Whenever you use an action with the fire trait
that you gained from this archetype, your forge
weakens keeping your from using actions with
the fire trait you gained from this archetype
until you spend 10 minutes fanning the flame.
The DC for an ability gained via this archetype is
either your class DC or spell DC, whichever is
higher, and is called your blacksmith DC.

You gain the Temper Weapon action

listCustomFeats.name: Blade Barrage
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance
You fling your blades across the battlefield,
focusing on speed rather than precision. Make
two thrown Strikes. Apply your multiple attack
penalty to the Strikes normally.

listCustomFeats.name: Blade Spin
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance and your Favored Blade is a melee weapon

With a quick movement, your blades spin around
you, tearing your enemies away. All creature
within your Favored Blade reach takes damage
equal to your Favored Blade damage dice with a
with a basic reflex save against your soaring
blade DC. The damage type is the same as your
Favored Blade. The DC of this action is affected
by your multiple attack penalty

listCustomFeats.name: Blade Surfing
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance

You hop on one copy of your Favored Blade. You
gain a fly equal to your land speed. As long as
you're surfing on your blade, it doesn't count as
flying above you.

You can dismiss this effect as a single action
with the concentrate trait, the blade flying back
above you. If you dismiss this effect while in the
air, you start falling normally.

listCustomFeats.name: Brawler Dedication
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Your punches hit hard as steel. Increase the die
size of your Fist and of melee weapons with the
free-hand trait you wield by one step.

listCustomFeats.name: Calloused Hide
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
The physical work and the heat of the forge has
left you with a skin akin to leather. You gain 3 additional
Hit Points for each blacksmith archetype feat
you have. As you continue selecting blacksmith
archetype class feats, you continue to gain
additional Hit Points in this way.

[Requirement : Class granting no more than 8+Constitution HP per level]

listCustomFeats.name: Deadly Sharpness
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You keep your blade's edges thin as a single
hair. Your swords with the Deadly trait also gain
the Tearing trait. On a critical hit with them,
increase the damage of the Deadly trait by one
die. If your weapon has a major striking rune,
increase it by two dice instead.

listCustomFeats.name: Downpour of Steel
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance


Your blades rain down all around you. Make a
thrown Strike against each foes within your
blade's first range increment. Those strikes deal
splash damage equal to the number of copied
blades flying above you, but the same enemy
can only take splash damage once from this
activity. Each Strike count towards your multiple
attack penalty, but do not increase your penalty
until you have made all your attacks. After using
this activity, you exit your Bladework Stance.

listCustomFeats.name: Endless Countermeasures
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You react so quick that anyone would
mistakenly think your body reacts before your
mind. At the start of each enemy's turn, you
gain you gain a reaction you can use only during
that turn for any reaction gained from a feat of
this archetype

listCustomFeats.name: Eternal Flame
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement Your portable forge is weakened

The fire of your forge never tire. Your forge turns
back on, allowing you to use actions with the
fire trait.

listCustomFeats.name: Finishing Sheathe
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Trigger Your melee Strike with a sword would
reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points
Requirement You're wielding the triggering sword

You sheathe your sword just as life exits your
foe's body, forcing everyone to recognize you as
a menace. Interact to stow your sword, then roll
a single check to intimidate all enemies within
30 ft. Add your sword's item bonus to attack
rolls to the check to Feint or Demoralize.

listCustomFeats.name: Fleet Footwork
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Trigger A creature targets you with a melee attack
Requirement You're unarmored or wearing Light
armor

You swiftly dodge out of the way. You Step away
from the triggering creature and gain a +2
circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering
attack

listCustomFeats.name: Float and Sting
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You dart around the battlefield, giving you the
momentum to strike. Step and Strike with your
Fist or a free-hand weapon, in any order.

listCustomFeats.name: Flying Pincer
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance

Using two blades at once, you force your enemy
between a blade and a sharp place. Make two
Strikes against the same enemy the first one at
your current attack penalty and the second at a -2 penalty. The enemy is off-guard against both
Strikes. At least one of them must be a thrown
Strike with a copy of your blade.

listCustomFeats.name: Focused Parry
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
As steel whirls around you, foes who try to
attack you are blocked effortlessly. While you're
in Bladework Stance, your Favored Blade gains
the parry trait. If it already has it, the
circumstance bonus to ac increases to +2.

listCustomFeats.name: Focused Riposte
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Trigger An enemy within your weapon's first range
increment critically misses you with a Strike
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance and have
a circumstance bonus to AC from the parry trait

Steel fly around you to protect and attack. You
Strike the triggering enemy.

listCustomFeats.name: Forge on the Road
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
[one-action] or [two-actions]
You quickly run across the battlefield, bringing
your skill exactly where it is needed. If you used
one action, Stride then use an action with the
Temper trait. If you used two actions, Stride
then use a two-action activity with the Temper
trait instead.

listCustomFeats.name: Harrying Sheathe
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're unarmored

As you sheathe your sword, you use the
scabbard to mess with your foe's footing.
Interact to stow a sword you're holding then
Reposition or Trip a foe. Add your sword's item
bonus to attack rolls to the check to Reposition
or Trip.

listCustomFeats.name: Heat Haze
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wearing your portable forge

You let the fire of your forge heat up the air
around you creating a shimmering mist around
you. You create a 10 ft. emanation around you
for 1 minute. Creatures inside the emanation are
concealed from ranged attacks. Any creature
other than you starts its turn inside the
emanation takes fire damage equal to half your
level.
Once per round on subsequent turns, you can
spend a single action to turn up the heat,
increasing the size of the emanation by 10 ft.

listCustomFeats.name: Hecatomb Slash
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You dash around the battlefield too quickly for
the eyes to react, reaping your enemies along
the way like mere wheat. Teleport yourself in a
straight line up to your speed, twice. Any enemy
in the way of those lines is Marked as if you had
successfully passed through them with Phantom
Slash. You then stow your sword and use
Delayed Injury, consuming your reaction as
normal. This activity count as three attacks
when calculating your multiple attack penalty.

listCustomFeats.name: Impaling Strikes
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
When you hit an enemy with a Strike with a copy
of your favored blade, you can have it stay stuck
in your enemy. They can remove it with a single
interact action.

You gain the Rending Recall action.

listCustomFeats.name: Instantaneous Riposte
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
When you use Preventive Strike, you can now
Strike if the triggering Strike was a failure. If you
make a Strike with this reaction, you can
Interact to stow your sword as a free action.

listCustomFeats.name: Iron Assault
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wielding two melee weapons, at
least one of them being a hammer

The cadence of hammering steel fits perfectly to
the rythm of combat. Make one Strikes with
each of the required weapons, both with the same target, each using your current multiple
attack penalty. If the second Strike is made with
a weapon that doesn’t have the agile trait, it
takes a –2 penalty.

If both attacks hit combine their damage for the
purpose of resistances and weaknesses. This
counts as two attacks when calculating your
multiple attack penalty.

You can give this action the fire trait. If you do
so, each Strike deals an additional 1d8 fire
damage. This increases to 2d8 fire damage if
the weapon has a major striking rune.

listCustomFeats.name: Lightning Draw
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Whenever you would use an action or activity
that requires you to be wielding a weapon, such
as a Strike, and you have a sword stowed on
your person, you can draw it as a free action
before the action or activity.

When you draw a sword and Strike with is as
part of the same action or activity, your target is
off-guard against the Strike. If you drew you
sword while using Phantom Slash or a similar
activity, all targets are off-guard to your
Delayed Injury reaction.

listCustomFeats.name: Masterful Runeforging
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
The utmost quality of the weapons and armor
you make lets them hold far more power than
one would imagine. Choose a single weapon or
suit of armor. While you're wearing or holding it,
it can have one more property rune than a
normal item of its kind. While you're not holding
or wearing it, the last rune you etched into it
becomes inert.

You can change the item affected by this feat by
spending one day of downtime reforging the
new item. If you do so without removing the
additional rune in the old item, it becomes inert
until you transfer it to another item.

listCustomFeats.name: Mobile Sheathe
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're unarmored

Your hands and legs move each on their own as
you better position yourself on the battlefield.
Step or Stride, then Interact to stow a sword
you're holding.

listCustomFeats.name: One-Two Punch
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
The steel that covers you give your hits a hefty
momentum. While you're wearing heavy armour,
your Fist and melee weapons with the free-hand
trait gain the forceful trait.

If you're wielding two weapons that fit this
criteria, treat them as the same weapon when
determining the bonus from the forceful trait

listCustomFeats.name: Overwork
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wearing your portable forge

You work more now, so your forge can rest later.
You become quickned for 1 minute. You can use
that extra action only to use an action or an
activity with the Temper trait.

listCustomFeats.name: Phantom Slash
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wielding a sword and are unarmored

You've learned to rush around the battlefield,
leaving wounds that they only feel a second
after the strike. You Tumble Through. If you
passed through the space of a creature, you can
mark them until the end of your turn.
You gain the Delayed Injury reaction.

listCustomFeats.name: Poise of Steel
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Your armour weighs you down so much that
moving you without your accord is a hardy task.
When you're wearing heavy armour, you gain a
+2 circumstance bonus to any defense against
Reposition, Shove, Trip, and other forced
movement.

listCustomFeats.name: Ponderous Sheathe
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're unarmored

Sheathing your sword offers you a moment of
respite to think about your next move. Recall
Knowledge, then Interact to stow a sword you're
holding. Add your sword's item bonus to attack
rolls to the check to Recall Knowledge.

listCustomFeats.name: Prepared Riposte
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wielding a sword or have one
stowed on you and are unarmored

You sheathe your sword and slow your
breathing. You can Interact to stow a sword
you're holding.
You gain the Preventive Strike reaction.

listCustomFeats.name: Put Some Spring in your Steps
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You bolt around the battlefield with ease. If
you're not wearing medium or heavy armour, you
can move up to 10 ft. whenever you Step,
including as part of another action or activity.

listCustomFeats.name: Raining Assault
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance

You let many blades fall down at once, so that
your target can't possibly dodge them all. Make
a Strike. It deals splash damage equals to the
number of blades flying over you. After this
Strike, all your flying blades fall in the space of
your target as if you had thrown them.

listCustomFeats.name: Ready for Combat
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Your mind is clear and your body acts quickly.
At the start of each of your turns, you gain an
additional reaction you can use for reactions
gained from a feat of this archetype

listCustomFeats.name: Revenant Style
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Your mastery of the Phantom Slash increases,
letting you slice and dice your way across the
battlefield. When you use Phantom Slash, you
no longer treat space occupied by an enemy as
difficult terrain, and you can try an acrobatic
check to pass through the space of an
additional enemy, marking it if you succeed.

listCustomFeats.name: Runeforging
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Your technical prowess has let you rediscover
strange etchings that can strenghten metal. You
can etch and transfer runes even if you're not
usually able to Craft magic items. You can
transfer or swap runes in an hour. If you're a
master in Crafting, you can do it in 10 minutes,
or 1 minute if you're legendary.

listCustomFeats.name: Sharp Steps
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance and one of
your copied blade could be recalled

You dash toward your blade to recover it in a
deadly flourish. Stride toward the required
blade. If you end your movement adjacent to it,
you immediatly pick it up and use Blade Spin.

listCustomFeats.name: Sheathed Blade Dedication
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You've trained yourself to draw your sword and
strike in the same movement. You gain the
Quick Draw feat, but can only use it with
weapons from the sword group.
You gain the Defensive Focus Reaction

listCustomFeats.name: Slashing Recall
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance
With a little more concentration, your blades
stay deadly even when returning to you. Recall
all blades within your Favored Blade first range
increment. Draw a line between you and the
starting position of the blade. Any creature
inside them takes damage equal to your Favored
Blade damage dice with a with a basic reflex
save against your soaring blade DC

The damage type is the same as your Favored
Blade. An enemy can only take this damage
once, even if inside the path of two or more
blades.

listCustomFeats.name: Soaring Blade Dedication
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Your mastery of your favored blade lets you
wield it with your mind alone. Choose either a
single one-handed slashing or piercing melee
weapon with the agile or finesse trait or a single
slashing or piercing one-handed ranged thrown
weapon. It becomes your Favored Blade. You can
change your favored blade by spending 1 day of
downtime with a new weapon. The DC for an
ability gained via this archetype is either your
class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, and is
called your soaring blade DC.
You gain the Bladework Stance action

listCustomFeats.name: Taunting Sheathe
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're unarmored
As you sheathe your sword in the middle of
combat, your foes are either coaxed into
imprudent attacks or unnerved by your
imperious demeanour. Feint or Demoralize a foe,
then Interact to stow a sword you're holding.
Add your sword's item bonus to attack rolls to
the check to Feint or Demoralize.

listCustomFeats.name: Temper Amor
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wearing your portable forge
and holding a one handed hammer

You quickly affix an armor with specialised
plates of metal, shaped to deflect blows,
slashes or stabs. You or a creature within your
reach gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing
or slashing damage equal to half your level for 1
minute, chosen when you take this action. Using
this activity again ends the oldest one.

You can give this activity the fire trait. If you do
so, the target gain resistance to two different
physical damage types of your choice, plus your
choice of fire or cold damage instead.

listCustomFeats.name: Temper Modification
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wearing your portable forge
and holding a one handed hammer

The heat of your forge lets you smelt some
temporary addition onto an existing weapon.
Choose a weapon you or a willing creature within
your reach is holding.

It gains the benefits of a basic modification for 1
minute, as if it was a weapon innovation from
the Inventor class. Using this activity again
ends the oldest one.

At 16th level, you can give this action the fire
trait to additionaly give the benefits of a
breakthrough modification the weapon for the
same duration.

listCustomFeats.name: Temper Shield
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wearing your portable forge
and holding a one handed hammer

You strenghten a shield with an additional layer
of protection. Choose a shield you or a creature
within your reach is holding. The next time this
shield is used to Shield Block within the next
minute, its hardness increases by half your
level.

You can give this action the fire trait. If you do
so, the next time the upgraded shield is used to
Shield Block a melee attack, the attacker takes
3d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save
against your blacksmith DC. At 8th level and
every two levels thereafter, the damage
increases by 1d6.

listCustomFeats.name: Tenacious Furnace
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Trigger You use an action with the fire trait that
you've gained from this archetype
Frequency Once per 10 minutes
Requirement You're wearing your portable forge
Your forge has seen worse than a little
overworking. Your Portable Forge doesn't
weaken, letting you use other actions with the
fire trait.

listCustomFeats.name: Trick Punch
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You land a clean hit right where you want it.
Make a Strike with your Fist or a free-hand
melee weapon. This counts as two attacks when
calculating your multiple attack penalty. If you
hit you deal an additional die of weapon damage
and apply the critical specialization effect from
you weapon. On a critical hit, apply the
improved critical specialization effect of the
grievous rune.

listCustomFeats.name: True Blade's Strike
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance

You coalesce all your blades into your Favored
Blade for a killing blow. Make a melee Strike
with your favoured blade. Its damage die
increases by one step, and for every blade flying
above you, you deal an additional die of
damage. This Strike count as three attacks when
calculating your multiple attack penalty. After
using this activity, you exit your Bladework
Stance

listCustomFeats.name: Ubiquitous Blade
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You're able to control your blades with more
precision over long distances. Your Favored
Blade gain the Reach trait and the range of its
thrown trait becomes 25 ft. If they already had
the thrown trait, they instead increase their
range increment by 10 ft.

listCustomFeats.name: Underhanded Tactics
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Landing those underhanded blows has became
second nature for you. When you use Trick
Punch, it only counts as one attack when
calculating your multiple attack penalty.

If you land a critical hit with it and have access
to multiple critical specialization effects, you
can apply two of them, though only one benefits
from the additional effects of the grievous rune

listCustomFeats.name: Unmoving Slab
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
Requirement You're wearing heavy armor
You plant your feet firmly on the ground, so that
whoever tries to attack you rebounds of of your
armour. Until the start of your next turn, you
gain resistance to physical damage equal to half
your level. If a creature tries to Trip, Shove or
Reposition you and get a failure, they get a
critical failure instead.

listCustomFeats.name: Versatile Criticals
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You know exactly each weak spots to hit to get
the reactions you want. When you get a critical
hit with your Fist or a free-hand weapon, you
get its critical specialisation effect.
You can also choose to swap its critical
specialisation effect for another one, depending
on its damage type

Bludgeoning club or hammer
Piercing knife or spear
Slashing sword or axe

listCustomFeats.name: Violent Beatdown
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You overextend yourself to deliver a finishing
combo. Step once then Strike four times with
your Fist or a free-hand weapon. Increase your
multiple attack penalty once after the first two
Strikes, and once more after the two last
Strikes.

After using this activity, you're Stunned 1 and
Off-Guard until the beginning of your next turn

listCustomFeats.name: Weaving Assault
listCustomFeats.textDescription:
You flow around your enemies, weaving your
punches whenever you see an opening. Strike
twice with your Fist or a free-hand melee
weapon and Step twice, in any combination of
order you choose. Apply your multiple attack
penalty normally to these Strikes.

listCustomSpecial.name: Bladework Stance
listCustomSpecial.description:
Requirement You are wielding your Favored
Blade.

Effect You summon a number of copies of your
Favored blade equal to its number of weapon
damage dice and make them fly above you.
While a copy if flying above you, you count as
wielding it.
While in Bladework Stance, your Favored Blade
and its copies gains the Thrown 15 ft. trait, or
increase their range increment by 10 ft. if they
already have it.
You can use a single action with the concentrate
trait to call back one or more copies within your
Favored Blade first range increment, or to move
one of more copies flying around you to to any
place within your first range increment.
If a copy would return to your hand, due to the
effect of a returning rune for exemple, you can
immediatly make it fly above you.
Wielding your copied blade require focus and
synergy with your Favored Blade. Any effect that
would apply only to the Favored Blade, such as
the penalty to Strikes from the Disarm action,
also applies to the copies

listCustomSpecial.name: Defensive Focus
listCustomSpecial.description:
Trigger You would roll a Will or Reflex save or
be targeted by an attack
Requirement You're unarmored and are not
wielding any weapon and have a sword stowed
on your person

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the
triggering save or a +1 circumstance bonus to AC
against the triggering attack.

listCustomSpecial.name: Delayed Injury
listCustomSpecial.description:
Trigger You would Interact to stow a sword
Requirement At least one creature is marked
by Phantom Slash

Make a single Strike and compare the
result to the AC of all marked creatures. Roll
damage only once and apply it to each creature
you hit. If more than one creature was marked,
this count as two attacks when calculating your
multiple attack penalty. All marks are then
removed.

listCustomSpecial.name: Preventive Strike
listCustomSpecial.description:
Trigger A creature within your reach would
Strike you
Requirement You have a sword stowed on you,
are not wielding a weapon and have used
Prepared Riposte since the beginning of your
last turn

You draw your sword and gain a +2
circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering
Strike. If the triggering Strike is a critical
failure, you can Strike the triggering enemy.

listCustomSpecial.name: Punitive Strike
listCustomSpecial.description:
Trigger An enemy within 5 ft. of one a blade
you placed with Battlefield Control uses a
Manipulate action, makes a ranged Strike or
leaves a square during a Move action

You make a melee Strike the triggering
enemy, using the blade you placed to determine
your position. On a critical success, the
triggering action is disrupted.

listCustomSpecial.name: Rending Recall
listCustomSpecial.description:
Requirement You're in Bladework Stance and
an enemy within your Favored Blade first range
increment has at least one copy of your favored
blade stuck in them

You recall all blades within your
weapon's first range increment. Creatures take
1d6+1 persistent bleed damage for each blade
that were stuck in them with a basic fortitude
save against your soaring blade DC

listCustomSpecial.name: Temper Weapon
listCustomSpecial.description:
Requirement You're wearing your portable
forge and holding a one-handed hammer.

You offer a quick polish to a weapon to
let it strike true. Choose a weapon held by you
or a creature within your reach. Until the end of
your next turn, it deals 1 additional damage per
weapon damage die to creatures it strikes. The
damage type is the same as your weapon.
You can give this action the fire trait. If you do
so, the weapons deals 3 additional fire damage
per weapon damage die instead.
